h1: We built the hiring system that hire.

headings.text: We built the hiring system that hire.
From HR Frustration to Recruiting Innovation
From a broken model to a hiring throughput system
AI in Recruitment: Hype vs. Reality

sections: We built the hiring system that hire.
From HR Frustration to Recruiting Innovation
From a broken model to a hiring throughput system
textBlocks: After years of watching brilliant companies struggle with broken recruiting, we stopped complaining and started building.

TaaSFlow was founded by HR and talent acquisition leaders with 24+ years of combined frontline recruiting experience across the UAE, US, Europe, Asia, and South America. We've placed over 20,000 candidates in 50+ countries — partnering with HR teams at 80+ companies from startups to global enterprises.

We lived every pain point that HR and people teams face: overloaded recruiters, agencies charging 20–30% placement fees with zero accountability, ATS tools that create more work than they solve, and hiring managers left waiting months for qualified shortlists. We knew the talent acquisition function deserved better.
Read more about the true cost of agency recruiting →

So we built TaaSFlow as the recruiting arm your HR team always needed — a subscription-based talent acquisition partner with AI-powered sourcing, structured screening, and weekly candidate delivery. No placement fees. No long-term contracts.

Think of us as your on-demand recruiting department: we plug into your existing HR workflow, align with your hiring managers, and deliver pre-screened, scored candidates every week. Your people team stays in control — we just make them 10× faster.
Discover our data-driven approach to recruiting →
The full story of why we exist, how we deliver, and why TAASFlow is a platform — not another agency.
Agencies, job boards, and RPO struggle at scale. Cost, speed, and quality fall apart under volume.
A subscription-based hiring system designed to replace fragmented labor with a single throughput engine.
Flat fees. Client-owned pipeline. Global multi-channel sourcing. Human-first, AI-assisted screening.
Intake → sourcing → scoring → shortlist → hire. A repeatable 8-step flow with weekly feedback loops.
One dashboard for sourcing, scoring, ranking, and decision-making — designed for HR, hiring managers, and finance.
Speed, cost, control, quality, and candidate experience — aligned across HR, CFO, Procurement, and Candidates.

We believe great hiring happens when everyone benefits. Our model is designed so that candidates, companies, and our team all succeed together — creating a virtuous cycle that gets better with every engagement.
Access to quality opportunities worldwide. No ghosting, transparent processes, and respectful treatment throughout.
Direct access to pre-screened, quality roles
Feedback at every stage — no black holes
Predictable costs, quality talent delivered weekly, and full pipeline ownership. Hiring becomes a system, not a crisis.
Sustainable partnerships replace transactional relationships. Our success is measured by your long-term hiring outcomes.
Continuous improvement via weekly feedback loops
Shared data drives better matching over time
From Silicon Valley to Dubai, São Paulo to Singapore — we source talent wherever it lives.
From single-person startups to Fortune 500 enterprises — here's the story our data tells.
Built careers advising global enterprises. Now applying that same rigor to the world of hiring.

25 years' experience of designing and driving value creation across Fortune 500s and Private Equity. Former Director at UBS Investment Bank and has led strategic programmes for Google, Barclays, HSBC, IBM and AstraZeneca. Very pragmatic and always looking to challenge and disrupt using technology as a key enabler. Strong experience in working directly with leadership teams, enabling growth and execution of business strategy.

Former strategist for Hilton, Marriott, Four Seasons, and Philips. Represented at G20 and B20 forums. Has built and scaled talent acquisition campaigns across the US, LATAM, Europe, and the Gulf. Passionate about employer branding, global talent markets, and building real connections at scale.
We adapt our process to every stage and size — because great hiring is universal.
From seed-stage to Series C, we help fast-growing companies build their core teams without the overhead of a full TA function.
First 10 engineers, founding sales teams, product leads
Companies with 200-1,000 employees that need to scale specific departments quickly while maintaining quality standards.
Engineering expansion, new market entry, department buildouts
Fortune 500 companies using us alongside their internal TA to access passive talent pools and reduce cost-per-hire.
Hard-to-fill specialized roles, global hiring, executive search
Everything we do is guided by these principles.
Every hire follows a repeatable, data-backed process designed to eliminate guesswork.
Sourcing talent across 50+ countries from 5 continents with local market expertise.
AI-powered scoring, ranking, and analytics at every step of the pipeline.
Weekly feedback loops that continuously improve candidate quality over time.
No hidden fees, no placement charges. You see exactly what you pay and what you get.
First ranked candidates delivered within 14 days. Every week, a new batch arrives.
Start with a 2 weeks pilot for 1 position. See ranked candidates in 14 days.
A global hiring system for teams that need consistent recruiting.
Weekly insights into talent acquisition. No spam.
No recruitment agency fees. No placement charges. Subscription-based hiring system.

textBlocks: After years of watching brilliant teams struggle with a broken recruiting model, we stopped complaining and started building. TaaSFlow is a subscription recruiting service — evidence-based, transparent, and owned by the client.

TaaSFlow was founded by HR and talent acquisition leaders who lived every pain point people teams face: overloaded recruiters, agencies charging placement fees with little accountability, tools that create more work than they solve, and hiring managers waiting months for a shortlist.

We knew the talent function deserved better. So we built TaaSFlow as the recruiting arm your HR team always wanted — a subscription-based partner with structured sourcing, evidence-first screening, and a candidate delivery cadence you can plan around. No placement fees. No long contracts.

Think of us as your on-demand recruiting department: we plug into your existing HR workflow, align with your hiring managers, and deliver pre-screened, scored candidates on a schedule. Your people team stays in control.
Sourcing across job boards, referrals, and outbound — mapped to your role.
Structured screening with role-specific screening questions.
Evidence-based scoring with citations from the candidate's CV.
Ranked delivery into a workspace your team can review together.
Every candidate score is backed by CV evidence. If we can't cite it, we don't claim it.

Great hiring happens when everyone benefits. Our model is built so that candidates, companies, and the TaaSFlow team all succeed together.
Direct access to real roles, transparent status, and honest feedback at every stage.
Ranked shortlists on a predictable cadence, with full pipeline ownership and one dashboard for decisions.
Subscription incentives align us with your long-term outcomes, not one-off placements.
